about: About Founded on the idea of empowering people to succeed in a digital world, IU International University of Applied Sciences first came into existence in 1998. And since receiving accreditation from the German Council of Science and Humanities, IU’s grown into Germany’s biggest university. The university's mission is to create inclusive, global and wholly accessible education. It’s why IU has been at the forefront of online learning for over a decade. It’s how IU made it possible for students to learn from anywhere and at any time — using the fully integrated digital platform, innovative learning tools and virtual classrooms. IU International University of Applied Sciences is state-recognised by the federal government of Thuringen, Germany, and its degrees are recognised around the world. For over 20 years, IU has established partnerships with leading global companies. This offers students the chance to gain firsthand experience through internships and projects and allow IU instructors to adapt the learning content to the ever-evolving needs of the labour market. Students will benefit from an education designed to bridge the gap between theory and real-world practice, ensuring their readiness for future careers. IU International University of Applied Science believes that the key for building high-quality study programmes is having a high-quality teaching staff. That’s why IU places an emphasis on finding the best professors and lecturers, whom all have to meet IU's high standards by having an excellent academic reputation, subject-specific expertise, practical experience and a strong international approach. IU’s advisory board, which offers expert advice to the university on research and education topics, consists of noted figures such as Jimmy Wales (Wikipedia), Raffaela Rein (Career Foundry), and Karina Montilla Edmonds (SAP), among others. Why IU International University of Applied Sciences - Berlin AI as a Teaching Tool: As a university that’s committed to getting graduates ready for success in the job market, IU believes that the key to continued success is to be able to adapt to changes quickly. That’s true for both students and for IU as a university. The International University of Applied Sciences has made it its mission to teach all IU students to learn how to work with AI, so IU students will develop AI skills as their professional superpower. They will sstudy along with Syntea, IU's GPT-powered AI tutor, and learn how to create effective prompts in IU's prompt engineering courses, available in every programme the university offers. Mission: What drives IU, is what drives students: The university designs its programmes to be as flexible and innovative as possible — without sacrificing quality. As a pioneer of digitalisation in vocational learning and personal development, IU sustainably, efficiently and measurably improves learning outcomes compared to all of its competitors and distinguish themselves with application-oriented research. IU combines its specialist expertise and focus on providing excellent student services, subject-specific knowledge, and transferable skills to prepare graduates for the international business world. Global Recognition: The International University of Applied Sciences is a member of the Association of African Universities (AAU) and the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) and were recognised by well-known organisations such as WES (US & Canada). International Peers: IU students live in over 170 countries, in 6 different continents. When studying and interacting with students from the USA, Canada, Sweden, Italy, the Netherlands and France, IU students will have plenty of opportunities to network on a global scale. Location: Dynamic, progressive Berlin is set to become Europe’s leading start-up hub and entrepreneurial capital. With a multinational population of around 3.76 million, the city is a powerhouse for networking and collaboration. The campus is located in the heart of Berlin, with around 2000 students studying in the cultural hotspot. Students have access to libraries and facilities across the city and we are happy to support in finding accommodation. Show More

about: About Hochschule Fresenius began life as the “Chemisches Laboratorium Fresenius” (Fresenius Chemical Laboratory) in 1848 and has evolved into a privately owned German university with a long educational history. It is the oldest educational institution of its type in the field of chemistry. It combines teaching, research, and practical experience exactly as envisaged by its founder, Carl Remigius Fresenius. Today Fresenius is more than just an institution that runs classes and hands out diplomas to graduates. They provide students with the conditions they need to grow both academically and personally. The friendly atmosphere allows for individual support and is the basis for collaborative and team-oriented learning. The school will make sure students have plenty of opportunities to interact with your fellow students, each one of them unique, but all sharing similar values. These interactions will help students to broaden both their horizons and personal networks. And this growth doesn’t stop once you graduate. Gone are the days when studying meant memorizing theoretical knowledge to be applied to practical situations at some later date. Hochschule Fresenius actively bridges the gap between theory and practice. This can take the form of case studies, practical projects involving companies from one's field of study, integrated internships, company visits, expert sessions, and lecturers whose own work experience makes topics more tangible. Close collaboration with the industry and regular re-accreditation ensure that our study programs keep pace with the times and emphasize relevant issues and skills. Thus, students will gain exactly the skills they will need to start their careers. Hochschule Fresenius is part of the Carl Remigius Fresenius Education Group, one of the largest private and independent education groups in Germany. This group includes, among others, AMD Akademie Mode & Design, Carl Remigius Medical School, Charlotte Fresenius Hochschule, Charlotte Fresenius Privatuniversität, escosign and Ludwig Fresenius Schulen. Through close cooperation within the network, the group covers the entire educational landscape from training to further education and university studies. In this way, people are offered a wide range of opportunities and enable them to engage in lifelong learning. Why Hochschulen Fresenius - Berlin Student Life: The General Students’ Committee (Allgemeiner Studierendenausschuss, or AStA) organizes several events throughout the semester, from student parties to on-campus summer and winter celebrations and the Frese Cup, a fun football tournament that takes place in a different city each semester. University sports are a great way to get to know fellow students. Working for the committee is an amazing way to promote student life at the university, students can contribute own ideas, and bring about changes in their everyday life. Student Body: The students are extremely diverse – not only in their backgrounds and nationalities, but also in their individual interests and passions. In addition to regular lectures, Hochschule Fresenius provides opportunities to enhance a student's personal and professional profiles. The extracurricular portfolio of free language and soft skills courses, workshops, and field trips will prepare students to start their careers. Students could learn to write a business plan and become entrepreneurs, they can spend a weekend in a European city with their fellow students getting to know leading companies in their field, or take part in a workshop teaching international students to find (student) jobs in Germany. Geographic Location: In European terms, Germany is a fairly large country with several world-famous cities. Hochschule Fresenius wants students to not only enjoy the experience of studying abroad, but also some of our most exciting places. The school has state-of-the-art campuses in various cities, allowing students to not only find their perfect study program, but also their perfect location. No matter which campus students choose, Hochschule Fresenius is a mere stone’s throw from world-famous historic sites and creative, lively districts with a wealth of cultural activities and destinations to enjoy during free time. And if students wish to experience life in a different city, many programs include the option to switch campuses during the course of their studies. Berlin: Berlin has many faces, and is much more than just Germany’s capital and political center. This vibrant, cosmopolitan city is brimming with culture and has an incredibly diverse population. With hip districts for various tastes, countless parks and green spaces, an abundance of sports, a whole host of sights, and a great atmosphere, it won’t take students long to fall in love with Berlin. Students come to this city to learn, and make the it their home. Show More

about: About GISMA Business School (Gisma University of Applied Sciences) was established in 1999 with an aim of offering globally recognised business and management education to ambitious students from around the world. Since then, it has partnered with a number of prestigious universities and currently has students from over 60 nationalities. Gisma combines theory with practice and will ensure students stay up to date with the ever-changing requirements of today’s global job market. All of the academic courses taught in English and Gisma also offers free German lessons at the Berlin campus to help students stand out from the crowd. Gisma offers a range of undergraduate and postgraduate degrees and foundation courses. The academic programmes are either awarded and delivered by Gisma University of Applied Sciences or taught in partnership with leading education institutions like Kingston University. Gisma’s hybrid learning offer is conducted in a virtual classroom, giving students from all over the world a classroom experience with live lectures and real-time interaction with other students. Gisma wants students to make the most of their time studying, whether in Germany at one of the campuses in the vibrant cities of Potsdam, Berlin, or via our virtual classrooms for online delivery. How and where students choose to study, they will be part of Gisma University of Applied Sciences community. Gisma University of Applied Sciences has two campuses in Germany, these are centrally located in Potsdam and Berlin. Why GISMA University of Applied Sciences - Potsdam Vision: To empower our students to lead the way in generating new knowledge, advancing tech, and creating a positive impact in the world. Mission: To empower future business leaders with the knowledge, skills, and network necessary to drive global impact and innovation. Expert Faculty: Professors at Gisma are experts in their respective fields. They have worked with some of the world’s largest and Location: Potsdam, a hub of technological innovation and economic growth, offers an unparalleled quality of living and a rich cultural tapestry. As the rapidly expanding capital of Brandenburg, Potsdam is celebrated for its vibrant economy and a plethora of leisure opportunities. The city is a stone’s throw away from Berlin, Germany’s dynamic capital, allowing students to enjoy the best of both worlds. With Berlin just a 20-minute train ride from Potsdam central station, and the international BER airport about 40 minutes by car, students living in Berlin can easily access the academic excellence of Gisma’s Potsdam campus. Potsdam’s economic landscape is diverse, featuring sectors such as Software & IT, Film & Media, Life Science, and Healthcare. The presence of global giants like Tesla and SAP in the vicinity adds to the city’s innovative aura, combining academic brilliance with a spirit of entrepreneurship. A UNESCO World Heritage city, Potsdam is a tourism gem with historic town quarters, gardens, castles, and vibrant music and theatre festivals. The scenic landscapes of forests, lakes, and castles offer serene study breaks for students. The surrounding region of Brandenburg, with over 3,000 lakes and 33,000 km of waterways, provides endless opportunities for day trips and exploration. Its medieval towns, specialist museums, and industrial culture sites are easily accessible for a quick getaway. Germany, known for its robust economy and high quality of life, continues to be the top choice for international students in Europe. With a shift towards sectors like finance, tech, and innovation, Germany’s demand for highly qualified professionals is soaring. International students are particularly welcomed, with an 18-month post-study visa available for non-EU graduates. Show More

about: About The University of Europe for Applied Sciences (UE) is a vibrant and dynamic institution that is dedicated to providing top-quality education to students from all around the world. UE's programmes are delivered in English and/or German language, and with more than 140 nationalities represented on campus, UE is proud to have one of the most diverse student bodies in Europe. The campus locations in Berlin, Potsdam, Hamburg, Iserlohn, and Dubai (UAE) provide a truly international experience for our students and staff alike. At UE is more than just a university – the university community is a family and it believes that employees are the most valuable asset, and UE is committed to creating a supportive and inclusive work environment where everyone can thrive. As part of the Global University Systems (GUS) network, UE offers a wide range of professional development opportunities, including bachelor’s and master’s degree programs, language courses, and executive education. With approximately 87,000 students across 57 locations worldwide, GUS provides an unparalleled international network for learning and collaboration. University of Europe for Applied Sciences (UE) - Hamburg Academic Ethos: Entrepreneurial thinking and independent action are the two pillars that form the foundation of UE's teaching. Course content is taught in a practical manner and in personal exchange with UE's teachers. Numerous practical projects prepare students for the time after their graduation. As a member of the Global University Systems network, which connects students on all continents, the University of Europe for Applied Sciences (UE) guarantees a global exchange, which enables us to offer our students semesters or internships abroad during their time in Germany. Campus: A diverse neighborhood, the central location of the campus, the economic and cultural offerings - there are many points that make our campus in Hamburg an attractive place for students from abroad to study here. The historic campus building is only a few minutes away from 'Altona' railway station and, thanks to the imposing cross vaults, bright courtyard, and modern facilities, our campus is always leaving some lasting impressions - not only to our students. Location: This Hanseatic city has been known for its open-mindedness and international attitude since its beginnings – making it the ideal environment to find innovative business ideas or creative inspiration. What’s more, Hamburg offers a lot of water, beautiful parks, and culture to ensure students can enjoy their leisure time to the fullest. The economic strength of the metropolitan region and its continuous growth make the Hanseatic city one of the largest economic, commercial, cultural, and logistics centers in North-West Europe. Students benefit from the numerous cooperations with internationally renowned agencies, publishing houses, and companies we are partnering with. Elbchaussee – the street of villas and parks – multicultural Ottensen, business elite, creative scene, fish sandwiches, and caviar: Altona is Hamburg’s most diverse district. In this melting pot, the University of Europe for Applied Sciences (UE) opened its new campus back in 2014. Since then, UE's created a center for our national and international students and teachers. about: About For over 35 years, mdh has been guiding students with their expertise and experience into one of the most exciting industries of the present - and future. Whether students are enrolled in a university program or a vocational training, they will be in close contact with mdh lecturers. Courses and classes are science based and project-oriented. Regular project work and a practical semester allow students to establish contact with relevant companies while they are still a student and help to improve teamwork between our participants. The master programs also focus on forming strong ties with the field of research. A total of 36 professors teaches at mdh, and our mdh Career Service helps students with the transition into the job market. Why mdh University of Applied Sciences - Berlin English Education: Berlin, as the German city with the highest proportion of English-speaking students, already plays a major role for mdh in terms of offering their degree programs in English. about: About GISMA Business School (Gisma University of Applied Sciences) was established in 1999 with an aim of offering globally recognised business and management education to ambitious students from around the world. Since then, it has partnered with a number of prestigious universities and currently has students from over 60 nationalities. Gisma combines theory with practice and will ensure students stay up to date with the ever-changing requirements of today’s global job market. All of the academic courses taught in English and Gisma also offers free German lessons at the Berlin campus to help students stand out from the crowd. Gisma offers a range of undergraduate and postgraduate degrees and foundation courses. The academic programmes are either awarded and delivered by Gisma University of Applied Sciences or taught in partnership with leading education institutions like Kingston University. Gisma’s hybrid learning offer is conducted in a virtual classroom, giving students from all over the world a classroom experience with live lectures and real-time interaction with other students. Gisma wants students to make the most of their time studying, whether in Germany at one of the campuses in the vibrant cities of Potsdam, Berlin, or via our virtual classrooms for online delivery. How and where students choose to study, they will be part of Gisma University of Applied Sciences community. Gisma University of Applied Sciences has two campuses in Germany, these are centrally located in Potsdam and Berlin. Why GISMA University of Applied Sciences - Berlin Vision: To empower our students to lead the way in generating new knowledge, advancing tech, and creating a positive impact in the world. Mission: To empower future business leaders with the knowledge, skills, and network necessary to drive global impact and innovation. Expert Faculty: Professors at Gisma are experts in their respective fields. They have worked with some of the world’s largest and most prestigious companies, including Amazon, United Nations, Harvard, KPMG, Boston Consulting Group, IBM, and Allianz. Location: Berlin, the capital of Germany and the largest city in the EU, has seen a huge resurgence in popularity over the last 30 years, whilst maintaining its cool status and affordable price tag with a thriving business scene offering a range of job opportunities to young professionals and graduates. In addition to its rich cultural and political history, it is now becoming famous for its wealth of flourishing start-up tech companies and a growing number of global giants now calling Berlin-Brandenburg home. With 500 new tech start-ups each year, the city is now considered the start-up capital of Europe. It is also home to some of the largest national and international companies in Germany from the tech, creative, health care, mobility & logistics, and service industries, making Berlin a popular destination for students looking to live and work in Germany after their studies. The city is also highly international, with people from over 180 nations living and working here. Berlin is also famous for its Freizeit (free-time) options – whether it is an all-night party at a club, exploring historical sights, or relaxing at one of the city’s 43 lakes or 2,500 public parks. The city is home to countless museums, galleries, opera houses, and theatres as well as the “Berlinale” as one of Europe’s most popular film festivals. It also has an incredible “foodie” scene, with cuisines from all over the world and restaurants, cafes, and bistros for every budget. Germany is the most popular option for international students looking to study in Europe due to its its high-quality education, career opportunities, and 18-month post-study visa, all of which you can experience with Gisma. about: About Hochschule Fresenius began life as the “Chemisches Laboratorium Fresenius” (Fresenius Chemical Laboratory) in 1848 and has evolved into a privately owned German university with a long educational history. It is the oldest educational institution of its type in the field of chemistry. It combines teaching, research, and practical experience exactly as envisaged by its founder, Carl Remigius Fresenius. Today Fresenius is more than just an institution that runs classes and hands out diplomas to graduates. They provide students with the conditions they need to grow both academically and personally. The friendly atmosphere allows for individual support and is the basis for collaborative and team-oriented learning. The school will make sure students have plenty of opportunities to interact with your fellow students, each one of them unique, but all sharing similar values. These interactions will help students to broaden both their horizons and personal networks. And this growth doesn’t stop once you graduate. Gone are the days when studying meant memorizing theoretical knowledge to be applied to practical situations at some later date. Hochschule Fresenius actively bridges the gap between theory and practice. This can take the form of case studies, practical projects involving companies from one's field of study, integrated internships, company visits, expert sessions, and lecturers whose own work experience makes topics more tangible. Close collaboration with the industry and regular re-accreditation ensure that our study programs keep pace with the times and emphasize relevant issues and skills. Thus, students will gain exactly the skills they will need to start their careers. Hochschule Fresenius is part of the Carl Remigius Fresenius Education Group, one of the largest private and independent education groups in Germany. This group includes, among others, AMD Akademie Mode & Design, Carl Remigius Medical School, Charlotte Fresenius Hochschule, Charlotte Fresenius Privatuniversität, escosign and Ludwig Fresenius Schulen. Through close cooperation within the network, the group covers the entire educational landscape from training to further education and university studies. In this way, people are offered a wide range of opportunities and enable them to engage in lifelong learning. Why Hochschulen Fresenius - Cologne Student Life: The General Students’ Committee (Allgemeiner Studierendenausschuss, or AStA) organizes several events throughout the semester, from student parties to on-campus summer and winter celebrations and the Frese Cup, a fun football tournament that takes place in a different city each semester. University sports are a great way to get to know fellow students. Working for the committee is an amazing way to promote student life at the university, students can contribute own ideas, and bring about changes in their everyday life. Student Body: The students are extremely diverse – not only in their backgrounds and nationalities, but also in their individual interests and passions. In addition to regular lectures, Hochschule Fresenius provides opportunities to enhance a student's personal and professional profiles. The extracurricular portfolio of free language and soft skills courses, workshops, and field trips will prepare students to start their careers. Students could learn to write a business plan and become entrepreneurs, they can spend a weekend in a European city with their fellow students getting to know leading companies in their field, or take part in a workshop teaching international students to find (student) jobs in Germany. Geographic Location: In European terms, Germany is a fairly large country with several world-famous cities. Hochschule Fresenius wants students to not only enjoy the experience of studying abroad, but also some of our most exciting places. The school has state-of-the-art campuses in various cities, allowing students to not only find their perfect study program, but also their perfect location. No matter which campus students choose, Hochschule Fresenius is a mere stone’s throw from world-famous historic sites and creative, lively districts with a wealth of cultural activities and destinations to enjoy during free time. And if students wish to experience life in a different city, many programs include the option to switch campuses during the course of their studies. Cologne: Life is never dull in this vibrant city, even when it isn’t full of carnival revelers – Cologne draws students in. Its long and eventful past is reflected in beautiful historic buildings such as the world-famous cathedral, the city hall, city walls, Romanesque churches, the “4711” building, and the modern architecture of the Rheinauhafen urban regeneration project. This tradition is matched equally by an innovative versatility, pioneering spirit, and wealth of ideas. If students need a little peace and quiet, they can visit one of the city’s many parks or let their mind drift as they stroll through the historic center or along the banks of the Rhine. Show More

about: About The University of Europe for Applied Sciences (UE) is a vibrant and dynamic institution that is dedicated to providing top-quality education to students from all around the world. UE's programmes are delivered in English and/or German language, and with more than 140 nationalities represented on campus, UE is proud to have one of the most diverse student bodies in Europe. The campus locations in Berlin, Potsdam, Hamburg, Iserlohn, and Dubai (UAE) provide a truly international experience for our students and staff alike. At UE is more than just a university – the university community is a family and it believes that employees are the most valuable asset, and UE is committed to creating a supportive and inclusive work environment where everyone can thrive. As part of the Global University Systems (GUS) network, UE offers a wide range of professional development opportunities, including bachelor’s and master’s degree programs, language courses, and executive education. With approximately 87,000 students across 57 locations worldwide, GUS provides an unparalleled international network for learning and collaboration. Why University of Europe for Applied Sciences (UE) - Berlin Location: Berlin is not only the capital but also the creative center of Germany. Countless events offer the opportunity to connect and network, which is a testament to the vibrancy of the German city. Berlin is famous for being a popular study destination - far beyond the European border: the German capital is in the global spotlight in terms of politics, business, culture, and sport. In addition to the many creative people, there have been many start-ups, founders, and entrepreneurs drawn to the city. Berlin's geographical location and international flair make it an economical hub for Europe and beyond. The campus of the University of Europe for Applied Sciences (UE) is located in the heart of the multicultural city, in the immediate vicinity of 'Potsdamer Platz'. With the help of modern digital technology, students can cooperate with companies across borders. This campus also has a workshop for creative entrepreneurs ('Gründerwerkstatt') and learning areas that help our students to build their careers. City Life: If creativity and entrepreneurial thinking blooms anywhere, then here. Students are guaranteed to have the inspiration they need every day to make their own design visions and business ideas a reality. Located between 'Potsdamer Platz' and 'Anhalter Bahnhof', in the hip district of Kreuzberg, the Berlin campus offers the ideal link to life in the big city. Once students leave the campus, they step into the fast-paced, creative and big city lifestyle with a number of cafés, bars, restaurants, museums, and historical sites all within walking distance. Also, the headquarters of many large international companies are in the immediate vicinity, such as the Axel Springer media group. The nearest shopping mall is just a few streets away. All corners of Berlin are easily accessible via the excellent public transportation network. Facilities: Business thinking, drawing, scribbling, and programming spread over close to 7,000 square feet. All UE students can use the large photo and radio studios as well as the green screen and animation studios. Spaces for creative and entrepreneurial projects, for example, the founders’ workshop and exhibition areas, are available to students on our campus. In addition, there are a big patio space, cafeteria, library, auditorium, and study areas. Quality of teaching: UE is among the 25 best schools with an international orientation worldwide. ""U-Multirank"" ranks UE as one of the 25 best universities in the world for the study abroad programmes and student mobility. More than 1,300 universities from over 90 countries were evaluated and rated on the basis of ten indicators. The ratio of students to faculty in science and teaching as well as the number of frequently cited publications and the quality of teaching played an essential role. Partnerships: The University of Europe for Applied Sciences is a member of the Berlin Partner network. Berlin Partner is a network from Berlin for Berlin that supports companies based here, links them with each other and actively promotes business, technology and innovation. As a member of this network, UE and its students benefit from valuable partnerships and cooperations that go beyond traditional teaching. Show More

about: About Hochschule Fresenius began life as the “Chemisches Laboratorium Fresenius” (Fresenius Chemical Laboratory) in 1848 and has evolved into a privately owned German university with a long educational history. It is the oldest educational institution of its type in the field of chemistry. It combines teaching, research, and practical experience exactly as envisaged by its founder, Carl Remigius Fresenius. Today Fresenius is more than just an institution that runs classes and hands out diplomas to graduates. They provide students with the conditions they need to grow both academically and personally. The friendly atmosphere allows for individual support and is the basis for collaborative and team-oriented learning. The school will make sure students have plenty of opportunities to interact with your fellow students, each one of them unique, but all sharing similar values. These interactions will help students to broaden both their horizons and personal networks. And this growth doesn’t stop once you graduate. Gone are the days when studying meant memorizing theoretical knowledge to be applied to practical situations at some later date. Hochschule Fresenius actively bridges the gap between theory and practice. This can take the form of case studies, practical projects involving companies from one's field of study, integrated internships, company visits, expert sessions, and lecturers whose own work experience makes topics more tangible. Close collaboration with the industry and regular re-accreditation ensure that our study programs keep pace with the times and emphasize relevant issues and skills. Thus, students will gain exactly the skills they will need to start their careers. Hochschule Fresenius is part of the Carl Remigius Fresenius Education Group, one of the largest private and independent education groups in Germany. This group includes, among others, AMD Akademie Mode & Design, Carl Remigius Medical School, Charlotte Fresenius Hochschule, Charlotte Fresenius Privatuniversität, escosign and Ludwig Fresenius Schulen. Through close cooperation within the network, the group covers the entire educational landscape from training to further education and university studies. In this way, people are offered a wide range of opportunities and enable them to engage in lifelong learning. Hochschulen Fresenius - Hamburg Student Life: The General Students’ Committee (Allgemeiner Studierendenausschuss, or AStA) organizes several events throughout the semester, from student parties to on-campus summer and winter celebrations and the Frese Cup, a fun football tournament that takes place in a different city each semester. University sports are a great way to get to know fellow students. Working for the committee is an amazing way to promote student life at the university, students can contribute own ideas, and bring about changes in their everyday life. Student Body: The students are extremely diverse – not only in their backgrounds and nationalities, but also in their individual interests and passions. In addition to regular lectures, Hochschule Fresenius provides opportunities to enhance a student's personal and professional profiles. The extracurricular portfolio of free language and soft skills courses, workshops, and field trips will prepare students to start their careers. Students could learn to write a business plan and become entrepreneurs, they can spend a weekend in a European city with their fellow students getting to know leading companies in their field, or take part in a workshop teaching international students to find (student) jobs in Germany. Geographic Location: In European terms, Germany is a fairly large country with several world-famous cities. Hochschule Fresenius wants students to not only enjoy the experience of studying abroad, but also some of our most exciting places. The school has state-of-the-art campuses in various cities, allowing students to not only find their perfect study program, but also their perfect location. No matter which campus students choose, Hochschule Fresenius is a mere stone’s throw from world-famous historic sites and creative, lively districts with a wealth of cultural activities and destinations to enjoy during free time. And if students wish to experience life in a different city, many programs include the option to switch campuses during the course of their studies. Hamburg: Hamburg is one of the most attractive cities in Germany. A lot of green and even more blue characterize the city, due to the high tree population, the open spaces, and the water. These colors symbolize the high quality of life. The different quarters with their unique character and charm make it a great place to live and to go out. From the Schanzenviertel to the Kiez, there are many opportunities to meet fellow students and get to know each other better. Striking and worth seeing places like the Michel, the Nikolai Church, the city hall, the Elbphilharmonie, the harbor with Speicherstadt or the fish market are a refreshing break from studying. Take a walk around the Binnenalster or the Waterkant to relax and unwind from the daily grind. Show More

UE's programmes are delivered in English and/or German language, and with more than 140 nationalities represented on campus, UE is proud to have one of the most diverse student bodies in Europe. At UE is more than just a university – the university community is a family and it believes that employees are the most valuable asset, and UE is committed to creating a supportive and inclusive work environment where everyone can thrive. As part of the Global University Systems (GUS) network, UE offers a wide range of professional development opportunities, including bachelor’s and master’s degree programs, language courses, and executive education. With approximately 87,000 students across 57 locations worldwide, GUS provides an unparalleled international network for learning and collaboration. University of Europe for Applied Sciences (UE) - Potsdam (Innovation Hub) The "Innovation Hub": Potsdam is a city approx. 25 min by public transport away from Berlin. It was selected in 2017 as one of the 12 digital hubs in Germany. It’s a cluster of world-leading companies in innovation such as the SAP Innovation Centre Network, Oracle, and the Volkswagen Group Future Centre Europe (with designers, experience experts, software developers, and IT professionals working on tomorrow’s mobility). UE's focus on technology, data, and design is reflected in the modern design of our campus’ building and its interior. Students benefit from geographical proximity to international brands and an atmosphere that promotes creative potential and ideas. The modern building not only offers enough physical space to develop but also enough mental space to create ideas and concepts. The exchange with fellow students from different fields and countries is important for this. Internationality is a top priority at the Innovation Hub, which is why all the study programmes are fully taught in English. Focus on Technology: UE Innovation Hub focuses on future technology and educate the leaders of tomorrow in a newly designed hub that enables students to learn in the most up-to-date educational environment. Students will gain a competitive skill set! UE Innovation Hub also believes the future is a combination of tech, data & design. The study programmes at UE Innovation Hub offer a unique module mix that will be necessary to succeed in tomorrow's job market. Location: Students at the Innovation Hub have the choice of living in a relaxed atmosphere in Potsdam or in the vibrant German capital of Berlin. The UE Innovation Hub is located in close proximity to Berlin's city center. The lakes around the area invite students to relax with their peers, especially during the summer semester. about: About Private University of Applied Sciences offers eight Master's programmes in management and engineering, each designed to equip students with the skills and knowledge for a smooth transition into the job market. PFH programmes are tailored to meet industry demands, and class sizes are kept small to ensure individual attention for every student. Recognised by the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture in 1995, PFH University of Applied Sciences is Lower Saxony's oldest private, state-recognised university. It was founded to align students to the real needs of the economy. Reaccredited by the Science Council, the university focuses on entrepreneurial thinking. There are two campus locations, Göttingen and Stade, as well as numerous distance learning centres across Germany and Austria. Why Private University of Applied Sciences (PFH) Practically-oriented study programmes : The content of PFH’s study programmes is geared to the real needs of business. Furthermore, all the PFH's on-campus study programmes contain a high practical element. Depending on the course of study, practical projects with collaborating companies, extensive work placements and/or technical qualification in laboratories and workshops complement the theoretical content. This will remove any reality shock that students may face when entering working life. Effective Teaching Methodology : The demand for PFH graduates proves that the PFH's study programme concept is working well: 99 per cent of them find direct entry to a career in less than six months after completing their studies. Many are recruited even while they are studying. Individual supervision rather than full lecture theatres : PFH’s courses take place in small groups as opposed to in lecture theatres where lecturers hardly know their students. Professors are always ready to listen to students and advise them about subjects relating to their studies as well as questions concerning their career path. A study programme at the PFH will develop students individually in terms of both their subject matter and personal skills. PFH attaches importance to students always having a contact person for their concerns during their studies and to their goals. Show More

about: About New European College (NEC) is an international business school located in Munich, Germany - the economic locomotive of Europe. All courses are taught in small groups in English by an international faculty. NEC’s academic partner and degree-awarding institution is Wittenborg University of Applied Sciences (WUAS). Together with WUAS, New European College offers one of the most modern and forward-thinking approaches to business education in Germany, with Bachelor, Master and MBA programs fully taught in English and six intakes per academic year. The administration of NEC focuses on each student as an individual in order to guarantee an exceptional learning experience. New European College is located in the southern part of Munich on the west bank of the Isar River. It is easily accessible by public transportation (with a bus stop directly in front of the campus and 10 minutes walking distance to two new private and fully furnished dormitories). The campus is spacious and has a beautiful garden, where students can relax during breaks between lectures. The NEC Library offers a wide selection E-Library that is accessible 24 hours / 7 days a week. Why New European College Pragmatic Approach : Entrepreneurship & ethical leadership are core to NEC’s principal teachings. NEC believes in business learning and creation through the interaction of passionate and dedicated individuals. By limiting class-sizes (max. 25 people in each group), integrating group activities inside and outside of the classroom and ensuring frequent interaction amongst students and lecturers, NEC creates the ideal environment for students to develop into future business leaders. Mandatory Internship : With project weeks and mandatory internships, students enter the world of business and witness real-world managerial challenges. Students have the opportunity to experience what they have learned in class and implement solutions within real organizations and on real challenges. Upon successful completion of the internship, it is not uncommon for students to receive full-time position offers within the companies they have worked for. Secure Your Stay : NEC’s career services enable students to gain awareness and develop their personal career paths. Career services provides support throughout all phases of the students‘ career and equips students with the necessary understanding and tools to engage in professional opportunities. Graduates are eligible to receive an 18-Month Job-Seeker Visa allowing them to launch or progress their careers in Germany. A Global Perspective : NEC’s extensive business network encourages students to design their career path internationally. With a student body consisting of more than 43 nationalities, students find an abundance of global perspectives on issues and discussions throughout their studies and experiences. Germany’s Economic Heart : The vibrant and culturally rich city of Munich offers a combination of high-tech and traditional environments. Home to renowned corporations such as BMW, Siemens, Allianz and many more, Munich plays host to a wide-variety of international events and festivals. Being a short reach away from other European epicenters, students are open to explore some of the best sites and attractions Europe has to offer. Built for Success : Having one of the lowest unemployment rates in Europe and the lowest in Germany, abundant employment opportunities allows students to establish and continue their path in business in the economic heart of Bavaria. With the support of the administration & career service center, NEC helps students find the right place for their strengths, talents & passion to build their future. Show More

about: About Constructor University was founded with the support of the Free Hanseatic City of Bremen, the University of Bremen, and Rice University, Houston, Texas. Constructor University is a top-ranked private university in Bremen, Germany. English-speaking, international, and highly diverse, school enable students to achieve their full potential by upholding the highest standards in research and teaching. Why Constructor University? Vision: Committed to social good as well as regional and global economic development, Constructor University delivers top-class educational and personal development opportunities to its students in a stimulating, secure and highly diverse campus environment, through cutting-edge technology, learner-centered pedagogy, and excellent research and innovation delivered by a distinguished research faculty. History: Constructor University (previously called Jacobs University and International University Bremen) was founded in 1999 with the support of the University of Bremen, Rice University in Houston, Texas, and the Free Hanseatic City of Bremen. This year the university got preliminary state recognition by the Free Hanseatic City of Bremen.In fall 2001, 130 students from 40 countries arrived on campus and started their studies together with 27 professors – it was the start of the unique, highly international and diverse community that has become the hallmark of what marks Constructor University to this day.Ex-chancellor of Germany Helmut Schmidt presented the idea of the university in his speech at the official opening of the university in 2001. Strategic Planning: To expand their on-campus technology-enriched interdisciplinary programs for a multicultural group of students and to establish a large-scale online campus.Their commitment to research excellence is steadfast. They aim to significantly enhance their global research presence through strategic investments and collaborations in key areas. They are dedicated to establishing a solid financial base to support and expedite their growth, ensuring the sustained excellence of their institution. Show More

about: About Hochschule Fresenius began life as the “Chemisches Laboratorium Fresenius” (Fresenius Chemical Laboratory) in 1848 and has evolved into a privately owned German university with a long educational history. It is the oldest educational institution of its type in the field of chemistry. It combines teaching, research, and practical experience exactly as envisaged by its founder, Carl Remigius Fresenius. Today Fresenius is more than just an institution that runs classes and hands out diplomas to graduates. They provide students with the conditions they need to grow both academically and personally. The friendly atmosphere allows for individual support and is the basis for collaborative and team-oriented learning. The school will make sure students have plenty of opportunities to interact with your fellow students, each one of them unique, but all sharing similar values. These interactions will help students to broaden both their horizons and personal networks. And this growth doesn’t stop once you graduate. Gone are the days when studying meant memorizing theoretical knowledge to be applied to practical situations at some later date. Hochschule Fresenius actively bridges the gap between theory and practice. This can take the form of case studies, practical projects involving companies from one's field of study, integrated internships, company visits, expert sessions, and lecturers whose own work experience makes topics more tangible. Close collaboration with the industry and regular re-accreditation ensure that our study programs keep pace with the times and emphasize relevant issues and skills. Thus, students will gain exactly the skills they will need to start their careers. Hochschule Fresenius is part of the Carl Remigius Fresenius Education Group, one of the largest private and independent education groups in Germany. This group includes, among others, AMD Akademie Mode & Design, Carl Remigius Medical School, Charlotte Fresenius Hochschule, Charlotte Fresenius Privatuniversität, escosign and Ludwig Fresenius Schulen. Through close cooperation within the network, the group covers the entire educational landscape from training to further education and university studies. In this way, people are offered a wide range of opportunities and enable them to engage in lifelong learning. Why Hochschulen Fresenius - Idstein Student Life: The General Students’ Committee (Allgemeiner Studierendenausschuss, or AStA) organizes several events throughout the semester, from student parties to on-campus summer and winter celebrations and the Frese Cup, a fun football tournament that takes place in a different city each semester. University sports are a great way to get to know fellow students. Working for the committee is an amazing way to promote student life at the university, students can contribute own ideas, and bring about changes in their everyday life. Student Body: The students are extremely diverse – not only in their backgrounds and nationalities, but also in their individual interests and passions. In addition to regular lectures, Hochschule Fresenius provides opportunities to enhance a student's personal and professional profiles. The extracurricular portfolio of free language and soft skills courses, workshops, and field trips will prepare students to start their careers. Students could learn to write a business plan and become entrepreneurs, they can spend a weekend in a European city with their fellow students getting to know leading companies in their field, or take part in a workshop teaching international students to find (student) jobs in Germany. Geographic Location: In European terms, Germany is a fairly large country with several world-famous cities. Hochschule Fresenius wants students to not only enjoy the experience of studying abroad, but also some of our most exciting places. The school has state-of-the-art campuses in various cities, allowing students to not only find their perfect study program, but also their perfect location. No matter which campus students choose, Hochschule Fresenius is a mere stone’s throw from world-famous historic sites and creative, lively districts with a wealth of cultural activities and destinations to enjoy during free time. And if students wish to experience life in a different city, many programs include the option to switch campuses during the course of their studies. Idstein: In Idstein, students will find a pleasant small town atmosphere. The picturesque city center with its half-timbered houses, the cobbled streets, cozy cafes, and restaurants invites students to linger and chat with fellow students. Located in the beautiful nature of the Taunus, the region around the old Nassau residence city also offers many opportunities for outdoor activities. And those who are drawn to the big city can quickly reach the Rhine-Main area with the cities of Frankfurt, Wiesbaden, and Mainz. Show More

about: About The NIT – founded 1998 by Professors of the TUHH to be the first Business School in northern Germany. The Hamburg University of Technology TUHH is one of Germany's youngest and excellent technical universities. At the NIT Northern Institute of Technology Management in Hamburg, talented students from all over the world learn how to master management tasks responsibly. In ideal learning environments, they develop skills to master the challenges of fast moving environments and actively shape the world of tomorrow. They acquire these skills in NIT’s practice-oriented Technology Management program (MBA/M.A.) or in its innovative lifelong learning offers. Students can also accelerate their career with the rigorous Business Analytics & AI Master's. Designed for working professionals, this program equips students with the skills to drive data-driven innovation. Why Northern Institute of Technology Management Start-Ups : A successful start-up is founded at the NIT almost every year. And almost every year, this startup receives EXIST funding! At the NIT Northern Institute of Technology Management, students can develop their own business idea or even find their own startup. In the MyProject modules they are familiarized with all relevant business tools and concepts. The NIT curriculum covers the entire process from forming a business idea to finding investors, sales, and marketing. The following overview showcases a few of the many great ideas and startups that were founded by NIT Alumni during or after the Technology Management program. Internationally Acclaimed Faculty : NIT students’ excellent education is based on the know-how of international professors and faculty members with practical experience. They come from acclaimed universities in Europe, the USA, and Australia or from successful, international companies. Student Life : NIT provides students with a wide-ranging wealth of experience. Students, staff and network partners come together in after-work activities, at subject presentations, and at parties. In the process, they make what is special about the NIT’s unique community continue to grow. Many students live and learn under one roof and maintain close ties with the NIT as their new home. NIT staff are happy to be of assistance and will readily answer questions about studies, the building, and hints on where to go and what to see in Hamburg. Central location in Hamburg-Harburg : The NIT is located on the Campus of the known Technical University of Hamburg in the District of Hamburg-Harburg. Due to its central location south of the Elbe River, the NIT Campus can easily be reached by long-distance trains, by flight via Hamburg Airport, and local public transport. It’s only 15 minutes from Campus to the world famous Hamburg Harbour and the inner city of Hamburg with all its sightseeing spots like historical Townhall, cultural offers like Elbphilharmonie, international gastronomy, shopping amenities, Sports stadiums and concert halls, and relaxing spaces in beautiful parks, Zoo, Museums, and nature even in the inner city. about: About Founded in 1905, ICN Creative Business School is a private higher education institution recognized by the French State, qualified as an EESPIG, and located on 3 campuses: Nancy, Paris La Défense, and Berlin. The school offers a degree conferring a bachelor’s grade for its undergraduate programs (Bachelor’s in management) and a master’s grade for its Grande École program (Master’s level). Triply accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS, and a member of the CDEFM within the Conférence des Grandes Écoles, ICN Business School trains students and executives to foster innovation through creativity in businesses. The school features an innovative teaching approach called Art Technology Management (ATM), inspired by the Artem Alliance, established in partnership with Mines Nancy and the École Nationale Supérieure d’Art et de Design de Nancy (ENSAD). This approach is rooted in transdisciplinarity. Through several initiatives, ICN promotes the blending of disciplines (art, design, marketing, etc.) to train decision-makers who can adapt to an ever-changing professional world. Why ICN Creative Business School - Berlin Studying at ICN Business School Berlin provides a unique opportunity to experience life in one of the most dynamic and eccentric cities in the world: Berlin. Berlin is a city that never sleeps and is filled with life, culture, and art. Cultural scene : Berlin's art and culture scene is remarkable. The city has a rich history and is home to many museums, world-famous opera houses, exhibitions, and historical monuments. The East Side Gallery is the longest open-air gallery in the world and features more than 100 murals by artists from all over the world! Student Life : Berlin is known for its bustling nightlife. The city has over 4,500 bars and nightclubs and it is home to the famous Berghain Club, where world-renowned DJs come to play. The city's atypical districts, such as Kreutzberg, Alexanderplatz and Tegel, are representative of Berlin's eccentricity. International Dimension : Berlin's strong international dimension makes it a hub for people from all over the world. Students will discover kitchens, cultures and languages from all over the world! about: About The International School of Management (ISM) was founded in Dortmund in 1990. In July 2004, it became the first private university in North Rhine-Westphalia and the second nationwide to receive institutional accreditation from the German Wissenschaftsrat (Science and Humanities Council) for the maximum possible period of ten years. In June 2016, the Wissenschaftsrat decided to grant accreditation for another ten years. The ISM is thus the first private business school nationwide to receive accreditation for ten years twice in a row. ISM has seven campuses spread across Germany. Located in close proximity to thriving companies and bustling economic centers, our offer many opportunities for cooperation. Whether you choose to study at an ISM campus in the northernmost regions, the southernmost parts, or right in the heart of the country, you can take advantage of valuable connections with nearby employers. Our students are also well integrated into their home campus. Small learning groups ensure a personal atmosphere and encourage meaningful interaction between students and their professors. Why International School of Management (ISM) - Hamburg Picturesque City: No matter what time of day, in Hamburg people are greeted with "Moin" or "Moin-Moin". Hamburg attracts many students with its Hanseatic city charm. Because besides beautiful bridges, seagulls and ships, the city has a lot to offer. At the Landungsbrücken, Binnenalster, Elbphilharmonie and the Reeperbahn there is always something going on. The famous 'Speicherstadt' in the Hafen city district, together with the Kontorhaus district, are also UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Economic Powerhouse: Hamburg has become an economic and cultural center and, with the largest seaport in Germany, has connections all over the world. The logistics sector is therefore one of the leading industries in Hamburg, along with the media and information industry and medicine and biotechnology. Thanks to the numerous and innovative local companies in almost every industry, students have a good choice for internships during their studies and excellent career opportunities after graduation. about: About EBS is a state accredited private university with top rankings and accreditations from AACSB and the German Council of Science and Humanities. EBS Universität consists of the Business School, Law School and Executive School. They offer a wide range of business and law study programmes - from Bachelor's and First Law Degree to Master's, MBA, Executive MBA and continuing education programmes. Currently, 2,200 students from over 100 countries are studying on the campuses in Oestrich-Winkel (Business and Executive School) and Wiesbaden (Law School), 44 professors teach and conduct research, and more than 250 employees look after the institution and students. Oestrich-Winkel is located in the UNESCO world culture heritage and offers proximity to the Rhein-Main-area with Wiesbaden, Frankfurt and Mainz. Why EBS Universität Location : In order to perfectly combine theory and practice, EBS Universität is located in the heart of Europe, the Rhine-Main region – one of the strongest economic regions in the EU with 32,000 companies, including 2,200 high-tech production plants, sales and services enterprises and a population of 4.7 million. At EBS, students have the best view even during their studies: EBS Business School and EBS Law School are located amidst the vineyards of the Rheingau, in the romantic Rhine Valley, which with its medieval castles and monasteries and its beautiful landscape is recognized by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site. Proximity to Frankfurt : Another advantage of EBS Universität - the European financial metropolis of Frankfurt with its more than 430 national and international financial institutions, including the European Central Bank, is just a stone's throw away. Student Life : A close and informal relationship between students, faculty and other staff members is typical of the atmosphere at EBS Universität. EBS is a small university providing individual guidance and support. The climate on campus in Oestrich-Winkel with its historical buildings and green spaces is characterized by open and friendly communication. Campus life is not just about seminars and lectures. Faculty, administrative staff and students are all involved in a wide range of activities outside lectures and teaching. Show More

about: About Established in 1973, EU Business School (EU) is an international, professionally accredited, high-ranking business school with campuses in Barcelona, Geneva and Munich, as well as a Digital Campus. EU offers English-taught foundation, bachelor's, master's, and MBA programs in subjects that foster entrepreneurship, innovation, and leadership, which are highly sought-after by businesses. These subjects include business administration, digital communication, international relations, artificial intelligence for business, sports management, leisure and tourism management, among others. EU has been awarded a 5-Star rating in business school excellence by the world-renowned QS Stars Rating. CEO Magazine ranks their Online MBA program number one in the world, and their presential MBA programs in the top tier for global and European MBA programs. about: About The International School of Management (ISM) was founded in Dortmund in 1990. In July 2004, it became the first private university in North Rhine-Westphalia and the second nationwide to receive institutional accreditation from the German Wissenschaftsrat (Science and Humanities Council) for the maximum possible period of ten years. In June 2016, the Wissenschaftsrat decided to grant accreditation for another ten years. The ISM is thus the first private business school nationwide to receive accreditation for ten years twice in a row. ISM has seven campuses spread across Germany. Located in close proximity to thriving companies and bustling economic centers, our offer many opportunities for cooperation. Whether you choose to study at an ISM campus in the northernmost regions, the southernmost parts, or right in the heart of the country, you can take advantage of valuable connections with nearby employers. Our students are also well integrated into their home campus. Small learning groups ensure a personal atmosphere and encourage meaningful interaction between students and their professors. Why International School of Management (ISM) - Munich (München) Innovation Hub: Munich is the perfect study destination for those who enjoy living and studying in an innovative hub of high-tech and technology. Belonging to the top five German university cities thanks to its over 20 universities, Munich is also the seat of various prestigious research institutions (like several Max Planck and Fraunhofer institutes). Also when it comes to global technology, economics and education sciences, Munich is a landmark. Important international companies are headquartered there and cooperate with Munich's universities. Location: The Munich campus is just a few minutes walk from Königsplatz in the center of Munich and thus easily accessible from the main train station. The students there particularly appreciate the contrasts that make the Bavarian capital so special - cosmopolitan young people and traditions, big-city atmosphere and rural charm. The most important economic sectors in Munich are vehicle and mechanical engineering, tourism, electrical engineering as well as the IT industry. In addition, the Bavarian capital city is an important German media location. City Life: Many think of Munich as the city of the Oktoberfest, the world-famous folk and beer festival. But Munich has a lot more to offer than this: it is home to the football club FC Bayern München for whom students can cheer in the famous stadium Allianz Arena and it hosts the world's largest museum for Science and Technology as well as the German Museum (Deutsches Museum). Besides the vibrant cultural life, students can always enjoy food in a nice traditional restaurant, spend time in a beer garden, take a walk in the green lung of the city, the park Englischer Garten, or even take a trip to the Bavarian Alps. about: About The International School of Management (ISM) was founded in Dortmund in 1990. In July 2004, it became the first private university in North Rhine-Westphalia and the second nationwide to receive institutional accreditation from the German Wissenschaftsrat (Science and Humanities Council) for the maximum possible period of ten years. In June 2016, the Wissenschaftsrat decided to grant accreditation for another ten years. The ISM is thus the first private business school nationwide to receive accreditation for ten years twice in a row. ISM has seven campuses spread across Germany. Located in close proximity to thriving companies and bustling economic centers, our offer many opportunities for cooperation. Whether you choose to study at an ISM campus in the northernmost regions, the southernmost parts, or right in the heart of the country, you can take advantage of valuable connections with nearby employers. Our students are also well integrated into their home campus. Small learning groups ensure a personal atmosphere and encourage meaningful interaction between students and their professors. International School of Management (ISM) - Cologne (Köln) Campus Accessibility: Around 350 students are studying at the campus of the ISM Cologne University of Applied Sciences in the MediaPark, just a few minutes' walk from the Hansaring S-Bahn station. The Rhine metropolis is one of the most important business locations in Germany and impresses with its convenient location and a mix of different top industries. The region enjoys a long tradition as a center of trade and industry. In recent decades, the Cologne region has also been able to expand its position as a service and logistics center. Cologne is also well-known for being an innovative media city. Location: Visitors of Cologne can't miss the Cologne Cathedral (Dom) and the famous carnival. But the city on the Rhine has lots more to offer to its students. With around one million inhabitants, Cologne is the most populated city in North Rhine-Westphalia (NRW). The old town and the banks of the Rhine river attract numerous visitors. The Hohenzollern Bridge is a popular photo spot and the museums and historical monuments are also worth a visit. The Zülpicher Street and the trendy neighborhoods of Ehrenfeld, Kawartier Latäng and the Belgian quarter attract with their numerous pubs and invite guests to share a 'Kölsch' beer. Those who are new to the city of Cologne will love the open nature and the Rhenish cheerfulness. Show More

about: About The International School of Management (ISM) was founded in Dortmund in 1990. The city has many facets and the capital of Baden-Württemberg is also home to many well-known companies from the international business world.
